```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = NA)

library(icesTAF)

library(FLCore)
library(stockassessment)
library(FLSAM)

library(tidyverse)
library(pander)

model.path      <- file.path(".",'model')
output.path      <- file.path(".",'output')
report.path      <- file.path(".","report")

# Data settings

# single fleet data
runName <- 'pil_pelnord2025_sf'
wg      <- "pelnord2025"

load(file.path(model.path,paste0(runName,'.RData')))
name(pil.all) <- runName

panderOptions('keep.line.breaks', TRUE)

```


**Table 1. Sardine in the North West Africa region - Input data. Catch tonnage for all sub-regions and combined.**

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.asp=0.6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

pander::pandoc.table(as.data.frame(read.csv('output/caton.csv',check.names = FALSE)),
                     style="simple", split.tables=200, justify="right", missing=".")

```
